answer: To enroll, an applicant appears at a staffed outpost and trips a live radio beacon that signs a one-time presence window; one courier cannot cover a farm. They receive a serialized willow wand whose ring-density map is hashed on-ledger; only that physical grain survives a later raking-light audit, and a photo or 3D print fails. In a dark booth a turbulent nebula of droplets is released once, and a staffed camera records the unrepeatable scatter in the same second as the beacon pulse. Each fake seat costs a new journey, a new wand, and a new chamber take, and any mismatch burns the posted bond.
